additional_info.subject: RE: ID0413436-DC/SI-D/FR-[_SN: MP/R3170001702]Black screen. 24V in controller. CRM:02699000003
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0413436 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Regarding the issue of HMI black screen problem, please check the following below:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
Update the Dlogic firmware, if its not done in past.
Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.
Additionally, please refer the Q feedback for troubleshooting:
SI E Q-Feedback Q2301 Sicharge D - HMI Blackout Due To RFID Illumination - ID: 109816643 - Industry Support Siemens
Reason
Applicable

Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes

Yes

Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
